description: This PHP source file defines a controller class 'ViewMyAttendanceController' in the OrangeHRM HR management system. The class extends an abstract controller and is responsible for preparing a Vue.js component to display a user's attendance data, including handling request parameters and determining if the attendance data is editable based on user permissions.

classes.name: ViewMyAttendanceController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for rendering the user's attendance view, including setting up Vue component properties based on request parameters and user permissions.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with attendance data, sets properties like 'date' and 'is-editable' based on request query and user permissions.
